facts.image: red line = trace, yellow dot = click; panels: close-up, slice 0, slice 19

text: The trace was followed across 20 of 20 slices but cannot be trusted as it sits off the clicked layer with only 2.2 percent within 5 voxels and 0.4 percent within 2 voxels and a median distance of 13.7 voxels. It is weakest after the fix, having fallen from 47.1 percent within 5 voxels and a median distance of 5.4 voxels before the fix. The panels show the red line trace drifting from the yellow dot click in close-up and in slice 0 and slice 19. A person should check the red line against the yellow dot and against the visible sheet layer in each panel to re-seat the trace.
